English Literature.question: ৭) “When the fight begins within himself, a man's worth something” - quoted by which of the following prominent writers?

- When the fight begins within himself, a man's worth something.

- So absolutely good is truth, truth never hurts the teller.

- Men and Women (1855),

English Literature.question: ৪৩) The Romantic Period began in in-
English Literature.exp:
- The Romantic period began in 1798 with the first edition of Wordsworth's Lyrical Ballads and ended with the first Reformation Act in 1832.
- This period is also called the Revival of Romanticism because the romantic ideals of the Elizabethan Period revived during these years.
- Lyrical Ballads brought about a great change in literature, both in subject and style.
- Instead of urban people and grand style, rural people and common language were preferred.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman
